overall_notes: The paper focuses on Dialogue State Tracking using generation-based approaches. While DST is primarily structured prediction, it involves natural language generation of slot values. The extraction was generally accurate but needed minor normalization of duplicate items. The paper uses standard DST evaluation metrics (joint accuracy and slot accuracy) but no human or LLM-based evaluation.
